sources.title: FAR 13.106-3 Award and documentation
sources.source_claim: Simplified-acquisition awards require a fair-and-reasonable-price determination. Competitive quotations are preferred where possible. Catalog inclusion alone does not establish reasonableness; supporting records can include supplier, price, delivery and other terms.
sources.application: Relevant framework for the seven reported simplified-acquisition purchase orders. Determine the governing solicitation clauses, deviations and version for each action before alleging noncompliance.

sources.title: FAR 15.404-1 Proposal analysis techniques
sources.source_claim: Price analysis examines total price without evaluating individual cost elements or profit. Historical comparisons need a valid prior price and adjustments for material quantity, terms, item and market differences. Technical advice may be needed.
sources.application: Analytical guidance only here; do not infer that Part 15 procedures or certified cost or pricing data are mandatory for these simplified acquisitions.

sources.publisher: United States Department of Justice, Antitrust Division
sources.title: Red Flags Of Collusion
sources.source_claim: DOJ describes market concentration, shared proposal irregularities, repeat winner patterns, subcontracting to losing bidders and advance knowledge of competitors' bids as reasons to investigate possible collusion.
sources.application: Screening framework, not proof or a rule that any particular offer count establishes independent competition. Shared upstream products and common form templates require ordinary-explanation checks.

independent_mechanism_review.reason: The reviewer independently opened both official sources. The summary preserves dated pleas/admissions and separates contract volume from loss and alleged benefit amounts.
